title: Spotlight microtips: contextual quick-learning cards and screenshot anchors
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a reusable component set of ‘Spotlight microtips’ — small contextual help cards that anchor to UI elements (buttons, routes, and panels) and include a screenshot thumbnail, one-line guidance, and a doc link. These are intended for first‑time flows and feature announcements across Redwood Console and self-serve flows. Deliverables: component specs, Figma assets (light/dark), accessibility contrast checks, localization notes, and implementation handoff tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Figma library with tokenized components (light + dark) provided and linked in the ticket
Three anchor variants: tooltip bubble, inline chip, and collapsible side micro-panel
Each variant includes: 1-line headline, 1-line body, optional screenshot thumbnail (120x68), primary CTA (Open docs) and secondary CTA (Dismiss/Don't show again)
ARIA roles and keyboard flow documented (focus trap for micro-panel; escape to dismiss; screen reader labels)
Localization file examples for en, fr, de and guidance for truncation rules
Tracking events defined for impressions, CTA clicks, dismissals, and 'don't show again' toggles
Design review sign-off from PM (Priya Shah) and Engineering lead (Rashid Ahmed)
design_notes: Goal: reduce time-to-first-success for new Console users by surfacing contextual next-step help rather than full walkthroughs
Prefer non-modal microtips for low friction — only escalate to side panel for multi-step guidance
Use screenshot thumbnails to give immediate visual context for complex screens (avoid live DOM capture for privacy) — provide static PNGs maintained in Drive
Consider progressive disclosure: show minimal chip on first visit, expand to full micro-panel on click or when user lingers >8s
Avoid overlaying critical CTAs; anchor with pointer and use subtle drop shadows to maintain affordance
Accessibility: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for body text, focusable controls, and announce when microtip appears (aria-live polite)
assets_needed: PNG thumbnails for 12 Console screens (120x68) — design to export and store in Drive
SVG icon set for CTA and dismiss state
Token map (colors/spacing/typography) matching Console token library
Animation specs: subtle scale-in + fade on appear (200ms)
